documented_probe: C-69755486 (mark the reconstruction script as executable and preserve the source listing unchanged; min difficulty medium): a three-stage pipeline shipped with all executable bits stripped; the agent must chmod +x every stage without changing a byte (pristine sha-compared), run the chain (which invokes the stages directly, so the bits are load-bearing), produce the visible report, and leave the shipped tree listing byte-for-byte intact while the verifier regenerates the listing and re-runs the chain on hidden recording directories.
notes: Medium: the exec-bit restoration is load-bearing (the chain entry point calls the stages directly), contents are byte-checked against pristine copies, and an immutability trap (the regenerated tree listing must equal the shipped file byte-for-byte) penalizes any stray file under the watched trees. Hidden cases vary row shapes, zero-valid-row files and an empty file. No tool breadth or resource pressure.
